_doc: Each drawn person's age (from their own record: a birth date, else an age band), any face fitted to a picture of them, and any looks (complexion, hair, eyes, stature; T-3491). renderers/web/js/human-variation.js seeds everything else from the person id. Regenerate; never edit by hand.

age.basis: age band 20-32 (the person's record); the year inside it is seeded

stature.basis: Drawn from the stature of US Army recruits of 1815-20, 68.1 in on average (Sokoloff 1984), with the 2.5 in spread of the period's registers; no measure of him is known.

looks.basis: His complexion (fair), hair (brown) and eyes (hazel) are drawn in the register's own words from what the Register of Enlistments wrote of 199 men of the 22nd US Infantry, 1812-14; his own entry has not been read. The short crop is our choice for a soldier of the time.

age.basis: born 1848-01-01 (the person's record)

face.basis: Fitted to a photograph of her showing her whole face (the Chicago History Museum's 1892 conservatory photograph, ICHi-061818): the eye spacing, nose, mouth, chin and ear placement are read from it, against her own body's face, as far as the shared MakeHuman face axes can express them. Depth is read from a single three-quarter view, so an axis the marks say little about stays near her body's own (listed as mostly_prior). Her 1897 multigraph (five views at once, two in profile) is held as a cross-check, not fitted: its heads are too small in the copy held. Her full cheeks, jowl, broad jaw and nose's breadth are read by eye from the photograph (read_by_eye), not measured.
not_modelled: her colouring (the photographs are monochrome; skin and hair colours are chosen)
her hair as she wore it (drawn up to a crown of braids in 1897; the model wears the town's bun)

card.source_citation: Photograph of Frances Macbeth Glessner standing in a conservatory among potted plants, full length, in a high-necked gown with puffed sleeves and a ruffled collar, 4 March 1892. Chicago History Museum, ICHi-061818.

age.basis: born 1843 (the person's record)

card.source_citation: [John J. Glessner 1897'.
